alreadyRegistered.none: You have already registered, but we don’t have an email address for you yet.
alreadyRegistered.pending: You have already registered. We have sent a confirmation link to the address below. Until you open it, sign in with Bank ID.
alreadyRegistered.proved: You have already registered. Please use your email address to sign in next time.

contestantApp.identityProvider.emailIntro: Enter the email address you want to sign in with next time. We’ll send a confirmation link to it. You can continue right away. Until you open the link, sign in with Bank ID.
contestantApp.identityProvider.emailInUse: This email address is already used by another account. Enter a different address, or sign in with that address instead.
contestantApp.identityProvider.emailTakenNotice: The address you entered earlier is now used by another account, so it could not be added to yours. Enter a different address.

cancelled.content: You cancelled the identification, and nothing was saved. You can identify yourself again whenever you are ready.
cancelled.title: Identification cancelled

noRetry.content: We’re sorry, this is a problem on our side, and trying again will not help. Please contact support.
noRetry.title: Registration is not possible right now

retry.content: We’re sorry, the identification could not be completed. Please try again.
retry.title: Identification did not succeed

contestantApp.identityProvider.nameIntro: Enter your party’s name to continue.
contestantApp.identityProvider.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your details. Please try again. If the problem persists, please contact support.
